title: Release shift handoff cheatsheet
content:
Operator micro-journal / quick-run handoff

Purpose: compressed checklist + running notes I can dump to the next shift. Not a formal runbook — this is my personal condensed view for release day ops. Keep it short.

---
Before the window (T-90m to T-10m)
- T-90m: confirm release manifest built (sha + image tags). command: `make release-manifest && cat out/manifest.json | jq .tag`
- T-75m: verify canary cluster health: `k8s-get ns=canary`, pods in Running, no CrashLoopBackoff.
- T-60m: preflight smoke tests (local): `./scripts/smoke.sh --env=staging`. Expect: 200 on /health, /v1/generate responds < 800ms.
- T-45m: check DB migrations: pending? `./db/migrate status --env=staging`. If >0 pending, call DB lead (Diego).
- T-30m: update slack #releases with ETA and brief list: what will change + risk (see slack template below).
- T-20m: ensure canary traffic ramp policy ready (traffic-manager config). Quick-check: `trafficctl get policy release-<tag>`
- T-10m: snapshot observability dashboards (links in linked_artifacts), export current error-rate and latency charts.

Slack announcement template (paste to #releases and #eng-oncall):
- "Rolling out release <tag> to 3 regions starting 14:00 PST. Changes: inference runtime upgrade, model v2.2. Risk: medium (kernel tuning). Canary will run 5m -> 30% -> 100%. Watch p95, error rate. Escalation: @Diego, @Priya. Reply ACK to this message if ready."

Commands to run (sticky list I use)
- build + push: `make build && make push TAG=<tag>`
- apply manifest: `kubectl apply -f out/manifest-<tag>.yaml --context=cluster-prod`
- canary adjust: `trafficctl set --policy=release-<tag> --step=5m --percent=30`
- roll forward: `trafficctl promote release-<tag> --to=all`
- rollback: `trafficctl promote release-<prev-tag> --to=all` and `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference --namespace=prod` if partial.

Backports / PR quick list (things I had to cherry-pick for this release)
- PR 589: fix kv-cache eviction (cherry-picked to prod branch). Patch: apply `hotfix/kv-evict`
- PR 602: logging guard for malformed payloads (merged but flagged in canary)
- TODO: double-check that PR 615 (quantization flags) is excluded from this cut.

Early canary checks (first 10 minutes)
- [ ] p95 latency <= baseline + 20%
- [ ] error-rate <= baseline + 0.5% absolute
- [ ] no new CrashLoopBackoff or ImagePullBackOff errors
- [ ] top 3 endpoints by traffic match expected routing

If anything fails in canary (quick decision tree)
- Elevated errors but not system-critical: pause ramp, collect traces, revert one component at a time (runtime -> model -> infra). Notify on Slack with `:warning:` and callout to @eng-oncall.
- System-critical (inference unavailable or >3 regions affected): immediate rollback to prev-tag, open incident page (pagerduty) and call SRE. Use `trafficctl promote prev-tag` then run `kubectl rollout restart` if needed.

Escalation contacts (phone + slack)
- Diego Morales (DB & infra): @diego / +1-415-555-0122
- Priya Raman (runtime & model ops): @priya / +1-650-555-0199
- SRE Duty (rotate): see PagerDuty -> SRE-OnCall

Post-deploy checks (T+15m, T+1h, T+4h)
- T+15m: confirm canary -> 100% and stable metrics for 15m
- T+1h: spot-check logs for warnings: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND severity>=ERROR" --limit 50`
- T+4h: run synthetic test suite against all regions.

Handoff bullet for next shift (what I will leave in the handoff message)
- Release tag: <tag>
- Status: rolled to 100% / partial / rolled back
- Known issues: PR 602 shows increased WARN logs on /v1/stream (tracking ticket JIRA-RELEASE-754)
- Actions outstanding: follow up with runtime team to re-evaluate patchback 589; verify quantization toggle excluded from rollout.

Personal running notes (timestamps I add during the window)
- 13:27: preflight passed. small flake in canary job, restarted pod and re-ran smoke.
- 13:45: pushed manifest. canary at 5%. p95 +10% (expected).
- 13:53: error-rate ticked +0.6% on a single endpoint — pausing ramp. Collecting traces -> root cause: malformed payloads, PR602 suspected. Reverted that microchange in canary, values normalizing.
- 14:08: promoted to 30%. Observability shows stable.
- 14:42: promoted to 100%. Post-checks running.

Quick postmortem stub (fill after incident)
- What happened: short summary in one line
- Impact: who/what was affected (regions, customer-facing features)
- Root cause: short bullet(s)
- Mitigation taken: what rolled back, fixes applied
- Action items: owners + due dates

Handoff message (copy/paste)
- "Handoff: Release <tag> | Status: 100% promoted | Issues: small WARN spike on /v1/stream (JIRA-RELEASE-754). Actions: Priya to follow up on PR602, Diego to confirm DB migration clean. Logs and traces: linked in the release runbook. Ping me if anything looks off. -- Ava"

Notes to self (short-term learning)
- Add a compact healthcheck endpoint that exercises kv-cache + quant code paths.
- Add an automated preflight that mimics canary traffic pattern (5m at low qps).
- Consider a short 'hold' step between 30% and 100% in future rollouts for heavier infra changes.

---
End of my micro-journal. If you inherit this: feel free to prune and push to the shared runbook when stable.
